body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 4 units. It gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: When this Rite's next Echo resolves, it may affect one additional eligible target.
When this Rite's Echo resolves, it may also remove one normal Condition from an affected creature.

rider.title: IMBUEMENT RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The imbued creature is targeted by an Action. Echo: It gains +1 Defense against that Action.
